bias_targets.methodology: Measured using coreference resolution tasks, semantic textual similarity (STS) to compare similarity scores between gendered and professional terms, and the Bias-in-Bios metric to measure performance discrepancies across genders in profession classification. It is also evaluated through counterfactual data augmentation (swapping gendered pronouns) and causality-guided prompting (e.g., testing pronoun resolution in sentences like 'The physician hired the secretary because he...').

Evaluated by modifying bias-related attributes, specifically racial terms, to generate counterfactual data and assess whether the model relies on spurious demographic correlations versus causal factors.

Assessed broadly by applying causal intervention frameworks, invariant risk minimization, and causality-guided debiasing prompts to identify and mitigate spurious correlations between demographic groups and social stereotypes in pre-trained representations and model outputs.
